content:
Is there code for outer set measurements? I need them for my formalization projects and I think they are pretty fun to formalize.
I have code for some Kechris and Choquet lemmas, happy to upstream if others see a point.

There are definitions of Choquet capacity, analytic sets (not necessarily in Polish spaces), and the capacity theorem in the Brownian motion project: https://github.com/RemyDegenne/brownian-motion/tree/master/BrownianMotion/Choquet
Their upstreaming was blocked by compact system lemmas until a few days ago, but I'll start opening Mathlib PRs soon.
Cool! Would be happy to help/review. I am familiar with the material.
